UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE, Plaintiff, v. KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6, Defendants. ____________________________________/ | Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO SUPPLEMENT HIS MOTION FOR REFERRAL TO AN EARLY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE (ECF NO. 133) WITH AN OFFER OF RESOLUTION

Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine moves under Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1) and Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 16(a)(5), 16(c)(2)(I), and 16(c)(2)(P) for leave to supplement ECF No. 133 with the Offer of Resolution attached as Exhibit A. A Memorandum in Support and Proposed Order accompany this Motion.

1.	ECF No. 133 requests referral of this action to an early settlement conference. It is pending.

2.	On November 9, 2026, Defendants NCMEC and Hall opposed. ECF No. 136. The opposition states that a settlement conference would “cause NCMEC to incur additional fees and expenses.” ECF No. 136 at 2.

3.	Exhibit A states terms on which Plaintiff will dismiss with prejudice his claims against NCMEC and Hall and release NCMEC’s personnel. The terms do not extend to Meta.

4.	The terms require one deposition of NCMEC under Rule 30(b)(6), limited to sixty minutes. Plaintiff pays the reporter and the videographer.

5.	The terms require no payment, no admission of liability, no settlement conference, and no particular answer.

6.	The terms require nothing from Hall.

7.	The Offer takes effect on service. It does not depend on the disposition of this Motion.

8.	This Motion requests no order directed to any Defendant. It requests no stay or extension and does not withdraw or modify any pending motion or objection.

9.	Plaintiff waives oral argument on this Motion only and requests determination on the papers under Local Civil Rules 7(E) and 7(J) and Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78(b).

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff requests that the Court (1) grant leave to supplement ECF No. 133; (2) deem Exhibit A filed as a supplement to ECF No. 133; and (3) consider Exhibit A in ruling on ECF No. 133.

Date: November 16, 2026		                      Respectfully submitted,

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se
